standard_prerequisites.name: The vanishing of local cohomology above the dimension of the support and the bound cd(A, I) \leq dim(A)
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Author lemma lemma-cd-dimension, whose statement is reproduced verbatim as a context span of this card (source lines 758-764)
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the a priori bound cd(A, I) \leq d and the vanishing that makes the property P descend along surjections.

standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that a property of finite modules which holds for a module of full support and is inherited by quotients of direct sums holds for every finite module
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the end of the counted proof (source lines 3626-3628) and attributed to a lemma of another chapter (a cross-chapter pointer)
standard_prerequisites.use: Spreads the vanishing from the given module to all finite modules, which is what cd(A, I) < d means.

core_obligations: Isolate the property: the proof defines the property P(N) of a finite module N as the vanishing of its d-th local cohomology, using the a priori bound to know that all higher local cohomology vanishes for every finite module (proof lines 3605-3608)
Elementary permanence: the property is insensitive to direct sums and is inherited by quotients, the latter because one degree above d already vanishes for every finite module (proof lines 3609-3614)

Reduce to the minimal primes of maximal dimension: the proof lists the minimal primes p_i with dim(A/p_i) = d, notes that P holds for any module whose support misses them, and sets M_i = M/p_i M, whose support is V(p_i) by the hypothesis on the support of M (proof lines 3615-3623)

Quotients of direct sums: for any ideal J the module J M_i is a quotient of a direct sum of copies of M, hence satisfies P, and the cross-chapter structure statement then gives P for every finite module, so that cd(A, I) < d (proof lines 3624-3628)
proof_roadmap: 由 lemma-cd-dimension 得 cd(A,I) ≤ d，故对一切有限模 N 有 H^i_{V(I)}(N) = 0 (i > d)。令 P(N) 表示 H^d_{V(I)}(N) = 0；P 对直和可加、对满射继承。
取维数为 d 的极小素 p_1,…,p_n，令 M_i = M/p_iM（支撑恰为 V(p_i)，此处用 M 支撑的假设）。对任意理想 J，JM_i 是 M 的若干 copies 之直和的商，故满足 P；再用跨章的结构性引理可知一切有限模满足 P，即 cd(A,I) < d。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is a converse-type criterion: if the top local cohomology vanishes for one finite module whose support contains all the components of maximal dimension, then the cohomological dimension of the ideal is strictly smaller than the dimension of the ring (author lemma at source lines 3596-3602, label lemma-cd-top-vanishing-some-module). The proof (source lines 3604-3629) isolates the vanishing property of the top local cohomology, checks its behaviour under direct sums and quotients using the a priori dimension bound, reduces the problem to the minimal primes of maximal dimension via the modules M/p_i M, and then invokes a structural statement of another chapter to conclude that the property holds for all finite modules (proof lines 3624-3628). The reduction to the modules supported on the minimal primes is the content. H3.
